snippet.title: Extra Bright (To One / ASCII Soft - PS1 - 1996)
snippet.description:
"Extra Bright is a 3D shooter in which the player can choose between 3 different aircraft types (each of them with his own co-pilot: Sonia, Linda or Milly). The game features 7 different stages that a on-rail shooter classic style of gameplay. There are 3 different difficulty levels: Beginner, normal & hard. Between each level the story will be displayed showing an anime cutscene.

STORY:
735 New Era, the early morning.
It will be a time of peace in the entire universe due to the international agreements in the Conference on the Armistice Agreement between the Soviet Empire and the rest of the universe, but all will be ended when the fortress 'Sword of Justice' is launched and he decided to begin the war. And the federal 'military strategy management system programs' (MIST) make a global war strategy, without any official approval, the Council decided to put an end to MIST and to do that they choose a the best one of their pilots to make the attack and destroy the organization and the core unit, he ca choose one of 3 different partners (Sonia, Linda or Milly) to help him pilot the ship. To complete the mission they will use the new super attack planes, named Extra Bright: The goal is to capture the fortress and win this war.

Manufacturer's description:
Boarded the 'Extra Bright' new super fighter attack aircraft, according to navigate the girl go, 3D shooting outstanding sense of speed. Achieve the game feeling refreshed like roller coaster. Chosen from a sortie with the heroine of the three become the hero, to stop the runaway space fortress Sword Justice system!

Features:
Third person perspective.
3D graphics
Cartoon graphics
SCI-FI & Futuristic themes."
